test_title: PYST 17: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 24 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
‘P × Q’ means ‘P is the brother of Q’,

‘P – Q’ means ‘P is the wife of Q’,

‘P + Q’ means ‘P is the father of Q’,

‘P ÷ Q’ means ‘P is the daughter of Q’.

If ‘D × B – E + C – A’, then how is A related to E?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 P is
 
 

 Symbol
 x
 –
 +
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 Daughter
 
 

 to Q
 
 

Given: D × B – E + C – A

D × B → D is the brother of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fd88ba155a6ce87ba91992a5914d9e90c0da4530229999e424a1108143ec059.png] 

B – E → B is the wife of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d78e0806b8598e2d8f529e6f41c7c7806cc380067e08ca7bd91bf963a1d74e0.png] 

E + C → E is the father of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23c31ebf2ea9d6215cb4a1f45bee79a0656e0535e31169049e577cfbb306dac8.png] 

C – A → C is the wife of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53ef3f64675254e9b0dbab29c6c7a2a93ae635e27933d049f382d6c874ad8e05.png] 

Thus, A is the son-in-law of E.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
